in_marathi.name: Jnanadeepa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge + Deep + Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jnanadeepa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jnanadeepa is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Deep Light of Knowledge'. It is a spiritual and mythological name, and is often given to a girl in Hindu culture.
